description: This file defines the RelatedListViewSession class, which manages session data related to list views and related modules in the vtiger CRM system, including handling pagination and related module management.

classes.name: RelatedListViewSession
classes.description: A class that manages session data for related list views, including adding/removing related modules, pagination, and session state management.

methods.name: RelatedListViewSession
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the session with the current module and default start page.

methods.name: addRelatedModuleToSession
methods.description: Adds a related module to the session for the current module.

methods.name: removeRelatedModuleFromSession
methods.description: Removes a related module from the session for the current module.

methods.name: getRelatedModulesFromSession
methods.description: Retrieves all related modules stored in the session for the current module.

methods.name: saveRelatedModuleStartPage
methods.description: Saves the start page for a related module in the session.

methods.name: getCurrentPage
methods.description: Gets the current page number for a related module from the session.

methods.name: getRequestStartPage
methods.description: Retrieves and sanitizes the 'start' parameter from the request, defaulting to 1.

methods.name: getRequestCurrentPage
methods.description: Calculates the current page based on request parameters and total record count.
